title: Fight of the Century: Keynes vs. Hayek - Economics Rap Battle Round Two
summary: A hip-hop music video from EconStories in which Keynes and Hayek rap-battle over how to handle recessions and government spending. It is the second round after the first rap battle.
why: Offered as a quick, entertaining primer on Keynesian versus Austrian economics, especially for newcomers to Hayek.

quote.text: this throwback to the 2008 crisis is an easily consumed primer on Keynes vs Hayek
